item.title: Kodi addon settings
item.description:
These are the settings you see in Kodi, in Add-ons → Elementum → Configure. The list is generated from the addon’s settings.xml of the latest release, so it is always in sync with the addon.

  • Setting is the name shown in Kodi (English).
  • ID is the key used in settings.xml, in exported config files and in Kodi’s userdata/addon_data/plugin.video.elementum/settings.xml.
  • Default and Values show the default and the allowed values (for sliders, the range).
  • Rows in italics are hints Kodi shows inside the settings dialog.

Some settings are only visible when another one is enabled (for example, memory size only for the Memory storage).

item.title: Command-line options
item.description:
Normally the Kodi addon starts the elementum binary itself, and you don’t need any of this. You need it when you run the daemon separately from Kodi: on a NAS, in Docker, as a Linux daemon or Windows service, or on a platform that has no Elementum binary.

The binary is inside the addon zip, in resources/bin/<platform>/elementum (elementum.exe on Windows).

Flags

Flags use one dash and name=value form, e.g. -remoteHost=192.168.1.10. Run elementum -h to see the list for your version. Flags with a list type can be repeated, e.g. -listenInterfaces=eth0 -listenInterfaces=wlan0.
